items.title: Accelerate agentic AI with NVIDIA Nemotron models on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS
items.summary_1line: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is a 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that pairs reasoning and tool use with multimodal understanding. This post explores its architecture and use cases, then shows how to deploy it...
items.editor_note: First cloud-provider deployment guide: AWS covers the 120B MoE model's architecture and how to run it on EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS.

editorial.tldr: vLLM announced day-0 support for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on Oct 15, covering image, document and video input through OpenAI-compatible serving. OrcaRouter comparisons against Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp followed on Oct 16, and NVIDIA added speech with Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe on Oct 28.
editorial.whats_new: AWS published a guide on Oct 29 for deploying Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model, on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod EKS.
editorial.why_it_matters: Nemotron 3.5 now has a managed-Kubernetes deployment path on AWS alongside vLLM serving, so the decision shifts from whether you can host it to whether self-hosting beats a metered API.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you run multimodal document or video agents on AWS, compare the EKS/HyperPod path with your existing vLLM deployment on your own eval; for voice pipelines, test Transcribe on your own multilingual audio before swapping out your current ASR.

status.detail: Servable on vLLM since launch day; speech added Oct 28 and an AWS EKS/HyperPod deployment guide followed Oct 29.
